annotations.action: Check service and metrics availability first, then the oldest in-flight operation, recovery latch, and recent RPC/database errors. Verify finality before retrying; do not restart merely to reset the progress clock.
annotations.impact: Vault management or withdrawal funding may be stalled even if the process is running.
annotations.recovery: Confirm fresh completion timestamps and actual completed work. A vanished series or deliberately stopped worker is not proof of recovery.
annotations.summary: backyard has completed no work recently
annotations.trigger: No recorded completed work for about 3m; restarting does not reset this check.

annotations.action: Check service and metrics availability first, then the oldest in-flight operation, recovery latch, and recent RPC/database errors. Verify finality before retrying; do not restart merely to reset the progress clock.
annotations.impact: Vault management or withdrawal funding may be stalled even if the process is running.
annotations.recovery: Confirm fresh completion timestamps and actual completed work. A vanished series or deliberately stopped worker is not proof of recovery.
annotations.summary: backyard has completed no work recently
annotations.trigger: No recorded completed work for about 10m; restarting does not reset this check.

annotations.action: Check service and metrics availability first, then the oldest in-flight operation, recovery latch, and recent RPC/database errors. Verify finality before retrying; do not restart merely to reset the progress clock.
annotations.impact: Vault management or withdrawal funding may be stalled even if the process is running.
annotations.recovery: Confirm fresh completion timestamps and actual completed work. A vanished series or deliberately stopped worker is not proof of recovery.
annotations.summary: backyard has completed no work recently
annotations.trigger: No recorded completed work for about 30m; restarting does not reset this check.

annotations.summary: Vault withdrawal needs operator attention on test-route
annotations.impact: Pending vault withdrawals require operator attention; normal cooldown alone does not trigger this alert.
annotations.action: Read the current scoped withdrawal-health reason and timestamp. Compare pending demand, available cash and active operation with confirmed chain state. Review the specific guard; never clear latches or grant full-debt repayment just to clear the alert.
annotations.trigger: The persisted withdrawal-attention state remained active for 1 minute.
annotations.recovery: Verify a fresh assessment showing the blocker removed or funding progress resumed. Missing metrics can expire an alert and do not prove recovery; verify each user payment separately.

annotations.summary: Vault withdrawal health is unavailable
annotations.impact: Current withdrawal status cannot be established. Previously blocked withdrawals must not be treated as recovered.
annotations.action: Check the Backyard metrics endpoint, coherent observation timestamp, and database read/write errors. Restore the missing evidence path, then verify a new durable assessment; do not infer healthy withdrawals from a successful scrape alone.
annotations.trigger: Required withdrawal-health metrics are missing or the observation is over 5 minutes old; condition persisted for 1 minute.
annotations.recovery: Verify both health metrics exist and the observation advances from fresh confirmed evidence. A resolved freshness alert does not establish claimability or payment.

annotations.summary: Vault NAV report is overdue
annotations.trigger: A vault that holds value has had no NAV report land in over 3 hours (routine cadence is hourly), or no report time is exported at all; condition persisted for 5 minutes.
annotations.impact: The vault's reported NAV is stale, so deposits and withdrawals may be priced from an old value.
annotations.action: Read the route's latest REPORT_NAV operation and any manual-recovery latch or held decision that stops reports. Check RPC and database health, then verify the next report reconciles on chain; do not clear a latch or force a report just to silence the alert.
annotations.recovery: Verify a new REPORT_NAV reconciled and the exported report time advanced. A vanished series is not proof that reports resumed.

annotations.action: Find the first event with this exact code and alert time in the current worker release. Check RPC/database health and the persisted operation stage; verify chain finality before retrying signed work.
annotations.impact: Repeated work attempts failed; the cause has not been classified and payment status is unknown.
annotations.recovery: The failure condition stayed clear for 30 minutes. Verify fresh telemetry and successful work before closing the incident; missing metrics or an expired counter window alone does not prove the cause is fixed.
annotations.summary: backyard failure incident: selector_evaluate_unavailable
annotations.trigger: Opens after a failure-counter increase of at least 3 in 15 minutes persists for 5 minutes. Stays open until the condition remains clear for 30 minutes; this recovery hold can include periods when the worker is already recovering.

annotations.action: Identify the named lane and its oldest pending operation. Check its last error, downstream RPC/database dependency and ownership/reservation state. Resolve that lane without restarting or replaying unrelated lanes.
annotations.impact: One processing lane may be stuck while other lanes keep the worker healthy-looking.
annotations.recovery: Confirm this exact lane records new successful ticks and its backlog advances; progress in another lane is not sufficient.
annotations.summary: backyard lane test-lane has had no successful tick for 15m
annotations.trigger: This lane had no successful tick for over 15 minutes; condition persisted for 1 minute.

annotations.action: Inspect the oldest due claim or blocked slot, confirmed custody balances and existing pull/deposit transaction states. Resolve the actual blocker; do not pull the subscription again or mark the claim paid without chain evidence.
annotations.impact: At least one autodeposit obligation has not completed within the expected processing window.
annotations.recovery: Verify the overdue claim or slot is resolved from confirmed state and no newer overdue obligation remains.
annotations.summary: An autodeposit obligation has been waiting for over 1 hour
annotations.trigger: A selected deposit claim or continuously custody-blocked slot has waited over 1 hour.

annotations.action: Verify the payer identity and current confirmed SOL balance against the runbook reserve target. Arrange approved funding if needed; never substitute a user wallet or expose the signer key.
annotations.impact: The worker may soon lack enough SOL for transaction fees or account rent.
annotations.recovery: Verify the intended payer is above the reserve threshold and can fund the next expected fee/rent requirement.
annotations.summary: Configured fee payer is below its warning reserve
annotations.trigger: The configured payer has stayed below the warning reserve threshold for 5 minutes.

annotations.action: Check the confirmed payer balance and in-flight signatures. Arrange approved funding for the configured payer, then verify work resumes; do not replay a subscription pull or replace the signer to bypass the block.
annotations.impact: Fee/rent-dependent work may be blocked; the low balance alone does not establish which transactions already landed.
annotations.recovery: Verify adequate confirmed SOL and successful subsequent work. Funding a payer does not itself complete pending user transactions.
annotations.summary: Configured fee payer is below its critical reserve
annotations.trigger: The configured payer is below the critical reserve threshold.

annotations.action: Inspect the persisted operation status, signature, last-valid block height and RPC health. Reconcile landed effects or verify finalized expiry and signature absence before replacing work. Keep ambiguous reservations; never blindly resend.
annotations.impact: A transaction may be pending, landed but unreconciled, or awaiting safe expiry handling.
annotations.recovery: Confirm a journaled terminal outcome backed by chain evidence. A drop in the in-flight gauge alone is not proof of payment or safe retry.
annotations.summary: backyard has in-flight work without a terminal outcome
annotations.trigger: Work is in flight with no landed/failed outcome in the rolling 3-minute window, sustained for another 3 minutes.

annotations.action: Read the latest kamino_fleet_capacity log line for this reserve (held and movable capital, best destination, its room) and the fleet_opportunity_replanned and fleet_opportunity_deferred events. Find why the published moves do not land; do not raise limits or split holdings to clear it.
annotations.impact: Users in this reserve earn less than an eligible destination pays while that destination has room; no funds are at risk.
annotations.recovery: Confirm moves from this reserve land and its movable capital reads 0 on a fresh cycle. The series vanishing or a restart is not recovery.
annotations.summary: Earn capital in reserve AYL4LMc4ZCVyq3Z7XPJGWDM4H9PiWjqXAAuuHBEGVR2Z has had a better reserve with room for 6h
annotations.trigger: Some capital in this reserve had an eligible move to a better same-mint reserve with room on every planning cycle for 6 hours.

annotations.summary: Earn Max rwa lane AUTO/AUTO/PYUSD has had borrow room below its leverage target for 15m
annotations.trigger: The lane's debt reserve had over $1,000 of borrow room and the lane sat at least 0.05x below its stored leverage target for 15 minutes with no leverage_up borrow landing.
annotations.impact: The lane earns less than its stored leverage target would while its debt reserve could fund the borrow; no funds are at risk.
annotations.action: Read the latest 'leverage decision' line (reason, gain, cost, borrow, room) and the lane's loyal_backyard_hold reason (at_target: no approved up step; no_room: the step does not fit the chain). An approval refused as up_move_not_worth_cost is the cost model's answer, not a fault; anything else is why the borrow is not planned or does not land. Do not lower the target or raise limits to clear it.
annotations.recovery: Confirm a leverage_up borrow lands for the lane (backyard_leverage_up_landed) or the gap closes. The series vanishing or a restart is not recovery.

annotations.summary: Term-loan repayment is overdue on AUTO/AUTO/wYLDS
annotations.trigger: Debt remains under 24 hours from maturity for 15 minutes, after automatic repayment becomes due when renewal is unavailable.
annotations.impact: The automatic safety action has not cleared the debt. At maturity the loan becomes eligible for liquidation.
annotations.action: Check whether renewal or debt repayment is landing, the current debt balance and any blocked safety step. Verify in-flight signatures before intervening; do not manually roll the loan.
annotations.recovery: Verify a fresh observation proving zero debt or a renewed maturity. Missing telemetry is not repayment.

annotations.summary: A required loan-safety action is blocked on AUTO/AUTO/PYUSD
annotations.trigger: A hard-LTV or maturity repayment encountered insufficient room and the lane remains held for that reason for 2 minutes.
annotations.impact: Automatic debt reduction cannot protect the position while the liquidity or collateral constraint persists.
annotations.action: Inspect the current no_room cause, debt balance and executable repayment path. Check any in-flight signature; do not raise risk limits or bypass the guard.
annotations.recovery: Confirm the safety action landed or a fresh decision no longer requires it. Historical failure counters alone do not keep this alert open.

annotations.action: Check systemd state, the process, local metrics listener and recent startup/runtime logs. Distinguish a scrape problem from a crashed worker. Check persisted signed work before using the documented restart procedure.
annotations.impact: The worker may be down or its metrics endpoint may be unreachable; execution state is unknown.
annotations.recovery: Confirm metrics scraping, expected release and healthy work progress; a reachable metrics endpoint alone is not full recovery.
annotations.summary: loyal-backyard.service is not serving /metrics
annotations.trigger: Systemd reports the unit active/starting/stopping/failed but its metrics scrape has failed for 2 minutes.

annotations.action: Check the intended service state and the first startup error in its journal, including credentials, executable and resource failures. Restore only an intended active service using the runbook; never revive a retired worker.
annotations.impact: The service is not operating normally; its dependent processing may be unavailable.
annotations.recovery: Confirm the intended service is active on the expected release and its dependent work progresses. Disabled or removed services also stop this alert without proving recovery.
annotations.summary: loyal-backyard.service is
annotations.trigger: The named service has remained failed or stuck activating for 2 minutes.

annotations.action: Inspect the first exit cause, OOM/resource events, startup configuration and dependency failures. Check signed/in-flight state before remediation; stop repeated blind restarts and follow the release rollback/recovery runbook.
annotations.impact: The service is unstable and may repeatedly interrupt work or lose fresh observations.
annotations.recovery: Verify the restart count stabilizes and fresh work completes on the intended release; waiting for the counter window to expire is not a fix.
annotations.summary: loyal-backyard.service is repeatedly restarting
annotations.trigger: The service restart counter increased by more than 3 in 15 minutes.

annotations.action: Compare with the Privy dashboard under Billing > Fee sponsorship and the app's recent sponsored sends. Check for a gas price spike on the chains we sponsor, a looping client or a drained wallet; confirm auto-refill is on and the balance covers the hour.
annotations.impact: Sponsored gas is draining the Privy credit balance faster than normal sends explain, so users may soon fail to send.
annotations.recovery: Verify the one-hour spend reading is back under $0.50 on a fresh read and the credit balance is not falling. A stale reading does not prove recovery.
annotations.summary: Privy gas spend is $0.62 in the last hour
annotations.trigger: Privy gas credits charged over the last hour stayed above $0.50, about 50 sponsored sends at the $0.01 ceiling per send; condition persisted for 5 minutes.

annotations.action: Read the retail engine's recent Privy gas spend errors: a non-200 status, a currency other than usd or more wallets than the reader pages. Check the Privy status page and that the app secret is still valid.
annotations.impact: Unusual sponsored gas spend would go unnoticed, and the Privy credit balance cannot be checked from here.
annotations.recovery: Confirm the last-success timestamp advances every 5 minutes. A vanished series is not proof of recovery.
annotations.summary: Privy gas spend has not been read for 15m
annotations.trigger: No successful read of Privy's gas spend for over 15 minutes (three read intervals); condition persisted for 2 minutes.

annotations.action: Read loyal-web's 'bridge sponsored send refused' log lines for Privy's message. Check the Privy dashboard under Billing > Fee sponsorship for the credit balance and that the chain is enabled in the sponsorship policy.
annotations.impact: Users cannot move funds from that chain to Solana; the funds stay in their EVM wallet until sponsorship works again.
annotations.recovery: Confirm a fresh Move on that chain sends without a refusal and the counter stops increasing; the window expiring is not a fix.
annotations.summary: Privy refused to sponsor Move sends on base
annotations.trigger: Signed-in users' Moves from their EVM wallets to Solana reported at least 3 gas sponsorship refusals from Privy in the last 15 minutes.

annotations.action: Read the retail engine's 'bridge incoming unmoved' log line for this address. The user must press Confirm on Assets to move it, or support moves or refunds it.
annotations.impact: A user's funds sit on their EVM wallet and never reach their Solana balance until the user moves them or support does.
annotations.recovery: Confirm the next scan reads the address and its series reads 0; a missing series does not prove recovery.
annotations.summary: 25 usdt left unmoved on 0xbd03e1f47c2a9b6d0e53f8a14c7d26b9d5c48179 (ethereum)
annotations.trigger: A relay_signed EVM wallet held at least 0.1 units of a token with no inbound transfer confirmed for its wallet in the last 30 minutes, and every scan for 30 minutes found it still there; a gap in the scans under about 13 minutes, such as an engine restart, does not reset that clock.

annotations.action: The UI cannot move an amount under the chain minimum. Support refunds it or the user tops it up to the minimum; read the 'bridge incoming unmoved' log line with under_min=true for the amount.
annotations.impact: The balance is too small for the Move screen to bridge, so it stays on the EVM wallet until support acts.
annotations.recovery: Confirm the next scan reads the address and its series reads 0; a missing series does not prove recovery.
annotations.summary: 5 usdt on 0xbd03e1f47c2a9b6d0e53f8a14c7d26b9d5c48179 (ethereum) is under the chain minimum and cannot be moved
annotations.trigger: A relay_signed EVM wallet held at least 0.1 units of a token below its chain's minimum with no inbound transfer confirmed for its wallet, and every scan for 30 minutes found it still there; a gap in the scans under about 13 minutes, such as an engine restart, does not reset that clock.

annotations.action: Check the retail engine is running, that privy-gas-spend.conf credentials are installed on the retail unit and the role has SELECT on loyal_yield.evm_deposit_routes. Read the retail engine's 'bridge incoming scan failed' error.
annotations.impact: Funds left unmoved on a user's EVM wallet would go unnoticed.
annotations.recovery: Confirm the last-success timestamp advances every 10 minutes. A vanished series is not proof of recovery.
annotations.summary: The unmoved-funds scan has not completed for 35m
annotations.trigger: No scan read the relay_signed routes from the database for over 35 minutes (three scan intervals plus a tick of slack); condition persisted for 2 minutes.

annotations.action: Read the retail engine's 'bridge incoming scan incomplete' warning for the error and Privy status. Check Privy rate limits and that the address still exists as an Ethereum wallet in the Privy app.
annotations.impact: Funds left unmoved on those wallets go unnoticed while the reads fail, and their last known series stays as it was.
annotations.recovery: Confirm the failed-addresses gauge is back to 0 on the next scan.
annotations.summary: The unmoved-funds scan could not read 2 relay_signed EVM wallets
annotations.trigger: The last scan failed to read at least one relay_signed EVM wallet from Privy; condition persisted for 1 hour.

annotations.action: Look at pg_wal and the archive backlog first (`loyal-db-replica verify`), then the largest relations. Free space before the volume fills; do not delete WAL files by hand.
annotations.impact: Postgres stops when the volume is full, which takes down every Loyal database.
annotations.recovery: Verify free space is above 100 GiB and not falling.
annotations.summary: loyal-db-primary data volume has 1B free
annotations.trigger: Free space on /srv/postgresql stayed below 100 GiB for 5 minutes.

annotations.action: Check the pgbackrest archive backlog and Storage Box reachability, and any stalled replication slot (`loyal-db-replica verify`).
annotations.impact: WAL archiving to pgbackrest is behind or a slot holds the WAL, and the volume fills until Postgres stops.
annotations.recovery: Verify pg_wal is back below 60 GB and shrinking.
annotations.summary: loyal-db-primary pg_wal is 1B
annotations.trigger: pg_wal stayed above 60 GB for 5 minutes.

annotations.action: On loyal-db-primary run `systemctl status loyal-db-replica-metrics.service` and `journalctl -u loyal-db-replica-metrics`. Check node_exporter is scraped (LoyalMonitoringDown for job node).
annotations.impact: LoyalDbWalLarge is blind, so WAL growing behind a stalled pgbackrest archive would go unnoticed.
annotations.recovery: Verify the textfile modification time advances every minute.
annotations.summary: pg_wal size from loyal-db-primary is not updating
annotations.trigger: The loyal-db-replica-metrics timer has not rewritten the pg_wal textfile for 10 minutes, or loyal_db_pg_wal_bytes is gone.

annotations.action: Check the named exporter, Prometheus or Alertmanager service and local listener. For Alertmanager, inspect reload success and notification failure counters; after recovery verify worker scrapes, rule evaluation and notification delivery.
annotations.impact: Worker health or notification delivery may be invisible; absence of other alerts is not evidence that workers are healthy.
annotations.recovery: Verify the affected component plus end-to-end scraping, rule evaluation and notifications. Check the external heartbeat separately if the whole host was unavailable.
annotations.summary: alertmanager is not scrapeable
annotations.trigger: The named monitoring component has not been scrapeable for 2 minutes.

annotations.action: Check the external heartbeat receiver, host reachability and monitoring services. Do not silence the dead-man switch without restoring an independent health signal.
annotations.impact: If heartbeat delivery stops, the host or monitoring stack may be unavailable and unable to alert for itself.
annotations.recovery: Verify the external receiver is receiving current heartbeats and that normal worker alert delivery works.
annotations.summary: Alerting pipeline heartbeat
annotations.trigger: Continuous heartbeat; the external receiver must detect when it stops.

annotations.summary: Vault worker is unavailable
annotations.trigger: An expected vault worker has no successful metrics scrape for 2 minutes, including a stopped service or missing scrape target.
annotations.impact: Deposits, withdrawals and automatic loan protection may no longer be managed.
annotations.action: Check the named service, its expected release and first failure. Inspect unresolved signed operations before restarting; restore fresh vault observations.
annotations.recovery: Verify fresh observations and successful vault work after the service returns; a metrics endpoint alone is not sufficient.

annotations.summary: Vault management is paused for operator recovery
annotations.trigger: The persisted manual-recovery latch has remained active for 1 minute.
annotations.impact: The worker has stopped managing the vault, including automatic protection of any outstanding loans.
annotations.action: Read the recovery reason and operation journal, reconcile chain effects, and resolve the underlying fault before clearing the latch.
annotations.recovery: Verify the latch was explicitly cleared after safe reconciliation and fresh vault management resumed.

annotations.summary: Current holder value cannot be established
annotations.trigger: No coherent certified valuation for over 10 minutes, sustained for 5 minutes; a worker that never publishes one alerts after 5 minutes.
annotations.impact: The loss detector cannot establish current holder value. A healthy process or an old NAV report does not establish that funds are safe.
annotations.action: Check missing or expired exit quotes, reserve observations and NAV evidence. Restore a coherent valuation; do not substitute zero or an old report for missing value.
annotations.recovery: Verify the certified valuation timestamp advances from fresh evidence and review the first new per-share value.

annotations.summary: Estimated holder value per share has fallen
annotations.trigger: Certified value per share is more than 0.2% below a sustained five-minute value in the previous six hours, for 3 minutes.
annotations.impact: Holders may be losing value through execution costs, market moves or fees. Normal proportional deposits and withdrawals do not cause this signal; it is not proof of realized loss.
annotations.action: Compare the first decline with reconciled sales, debt credits, fees and collateral prices. Check whether further costly operations are planned and investigate their cause.
annotations.recovery: Verify fresh per-share observations are stable and the cause is addressed. Leaving the comparison window does not recover earlier losses.

annotations.summary: Automatic debt reduction has not restored the safety margin on AUTO/AUTO/wYLDS
annotations.trigger: The last observed LTV remains at or above the worker safety threshold for 2 minutes while debt is outstanding.
annotations.impact: The position is closer to liquidation than the configured safety margin permits.
annotations.action: Inspect current LTV, debt, collateral prices and the repayment operation. Check why automatic reduction is not landing; verify signatures before any intervention.
annotations.recovery: Verify a fresh observation below the safety threshold or explicitly repaid debt. A missing lane series is not evidence of safety.

annotations.summary: Loan has reached its liquidation threshold on AUTO/AUTO/wYLDS
annotations.trigger: The last coherent observation has LTV at or above the liquidation threshold and still shows outstanding debt.
annotations.impact: Collateral can be liquidated and holders can lose money now.
annotations.action: Immediately inspect confirmed debt and collateral, current prices and in-flight protective repayments. Coordinate recovery without duplicating a signed transaction.
annotations.recovery: Verify confirmed debt repayment or a restored liquidation margin from fresh evidence. Missing telemetry does not clear the known exposure.

annotations.summary: Loan risk cannot be refreshed on AUTO/AUTO/wYLDS
annotations.trigger: An outstanding loan has had no coherent debt and LTV observation for over 5 minutes, sustained for 5 minutes.
annotations.impact: Automatic protection is operating without a current view of this loan; the last healthy LTV may no longer apply.
annotations.action: Restore reserve and obligation observations and check the current position directly. Confirm the protection loop resumes with fresh chain evidence.
annotations.recovery: Verify a fresh risk observation or an explicit observation of zero debt; disappearing metrics do not prove recovery.

annotations.summary: Unpaid term loan has matured on AUTO/AUTO/wYLDS
annotations.trigger: The observed term has expired and the lane still has outstanding debt.
annotations.impact: The debt is eligible for maturity-based liquidation even if its price-based LTV looks healthy.
annotations.action: Immediately inspect the confirmed debt, repayment attempts and blocked safety action. Reconcile any in-flight signature before taking recovery action.
annotations.recovery: Verify fresh evidence of zero debt or an on-chain renewed maturity. Missing telemetry is not repayment.
